thread:
Maya: Daily async — onboarding tinyq-v2 (short).
What I did: ran an eval sweep across travel/qa/domains, baseline -> tinyq-v2. Spotting a small regression in the travel QA prompt set (precision -4%).
Blockers: can't reliably repro locally; quantized KV cache path seems to behave differently on CI GPUs (possible kernel/rounding mismatch). Need a quant profile tweak + small prompt set adjustment.
Today: pin a quant profile, open a tiny PR with prompt tweak + eval update, will ping for CR. cc @Oliver @Sam :mag:

Sam: Saw the CI artifact — thanks for the note. Can you paste the exact prompt set or minimal repro? I can try to reproduce on node-gpu-6.

Maya: Paste below (minimal snippet):
```json
{
  "id": "travel_regression_001",
  "prompt": "Q: Where should I store my passport when flying internationally?\nA:",
  "expected_contains": ["carry-on", "secure", "hotel safe"],
  "max_tokens": 64
}
```
Also running full prompt set: travel_qc_v3.json (attached to eval job).

ml-ci-bot: eval-run/tinyq-v2/1859004300 finished — status: partial-fail. Failures: travel_regression_001 (1/210). Artifacts: https://ci.redwood.ai/artifacts/1859004300 (logs + dumps).

Sam: I'll spin up repro with quant profile q2-hybrid-8 and MAX_SEQ=512, try both cpu-quant and cuda-quant paths. If I can repro, I'll bisect the quant kernel change. ETA ~ 20m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Oliver: I'll take the PR review once it's up. Quick ask — add a small eval assertion that checks for 'hotel safe' / synonyms so we don't regress silently. I can also add a CI gate for that prompt.

Riley: Infra note — the GPU pool used by tinyq-v2 got a driver bump yesterday; I didn't expect ABI changes but I'll confirm driver/kernel versions on node-gpu-6. No quota issues.

Maya: Thanks all. If Sam reproduces, save the quant state and include the raw logits dump (helps debug rounding). I'll draft the prompt tweak now: reduce leading context and prefer explicit examples to anchor the answer.

Sam: Repro successful on node-gpu-6 with q2-hybrid-8. Found op mismatch in KV gather where dtype cast dropped precision for certain indices — created debug dump and starting a minimal reproducer. PR incoming with repro + suggested kernel guard. Will attach logs. ETA for PR: ~1.5h. :wrench:

Oliver: Nice. Once PR is up I can land the prompt tweak + eval update together.

Maya: Perfect. I pushed the prompt tweak branch (tinyq/prompt-fixes) and added the new eval case. Linking PR in thread when Sam's repro PR is ready. :thumbsup:

ml-ci-bot: deploybot: noted PRs: tinyq/prompt-fixes (draft), sam/repro-kernel-guard (WIP).

Sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/tinyq/pull/238 — includes repro, test, and a suggested guard. Will iterate if tests fail. :party_parrot:

Maya: Thanks everyone — will follow up in next async. If anyone wants pairing on the kernel guard ping me.

Oliver: +1, will add the eval assertion after Sam's CI completes.

Riley: All infra checks look green from my side.

Sam: CI passed on the repro branch, kernel guard fixes floats-for-index bugs. Merging after one quick review.

Maya: Merged and rolled tinyq-v2 -> canary. Running a quick eval sweep now. Fingers crossed. :crossed_fingers:
